items.name: ProxyPilot-public
items.description: Run any AI model in Xcode Agent Mode. Change models without losing the thread. New: ProxyPilot Agent in Xcode 27. Use local models (Ollama and LM Studio) with no API key, or route to cloud routers and endpoints with per-provider keys. Includes GUI, CLI, and over a dozen MCP tools. Auditable telemetry (cache hit rate, TTFT, and more), every session.
